description: Shop account page in a utility CSS framework: labelled email and password with autocomplete hints, header product search and a footer discount sign-up.
Single-page app with no form element: two inputs named only by aria-label, no ids or names, a div acting as the button.
Social site log-in with placeholder-only fields ("Phone, email or username"), bracketed field names and a language picker in the footer.
Old forum header bar: table layout, the username box shows "User Name" as its value until focused, remember-me tick, and a forum search box in the sidebar.
Checkout gate with "Returning customer" log-in beside a "New customer" guest-checkout email box, plus a header search.
Building-society internet banking with unusual labels: "Customer number" (numeric keyboard) and "Passcode", a remember-number tick and a security notice.
Cinema site whose "Log in" header button opens a native dialog with the form; the header search stays on the page behind the backdrop.
Patient portal with floating labels placed after the inputs, "Member ID or email" as the identifier, and a show/hide password button that swaps the input type.
CRM log-in with generated ids and aria-labelledby labels, an off-screen "website" trap field, and an SSO company-email box inside a closed details element.
Rewards app with "Email" and "Mobile" tabs; the mobile tab's phone and password boxes sit in a hidden panel.
Identifier first, then a progress bar and a fade to a "Welcome" step that shows the account as a text chip, keeps the identifier in a hidden input and asks for the password.
Email step slides left and the password step slides in from the right with a back arrow showing the address; the email input is hidden once the slide ends.
Hosting control panel: username first, then the password box expands below while the username stays editable, so step two is a full sign-in.
Brokerage log-in that swaps to a "Check your phone" view with a single one-time-code box after a short spinner.
Webmail sign-in across two real pages: the email page navigates to a password page that shows the address as text and keeps it in session storage.
Account chooser listing two remembered accounts as buttons; picking one shows a password step with that account as text and a hidden login hint.
Bank "Online ID" first, then a route change that removes the first form, shows a skeleton, then the chosen security picture and phrase above a "Passcode" box.
Community site that embeds its log-in form from a same-origin page in an iframe beside the topic list; the site search is in the outer page.
Help centre embedding a "customer log-in" widget served from a different origin; the widget reports edits to the host page with postMessage.
Learning platform that inserts a srcdoc iframe with the sign-in form about a second after load, built from a template element.
A single custom element with an open shadow root holding its own form, labels and inputs.
Design-system components three shadow roots deep: an app shell, an auth card, and a text-field component wrapping each native input.
Layout component with a shadow root whose named slot shows light-DOM inputs; the inputs themselves are ordinary document nodes.
React-style app that fetches its config JSON, then mounts a controlled form; inputs carry only data-testid and name, and values live in component state.
Vue-style single-page app: the home view has a "Sign in" link to a hash route, which renders a login view whose inputs are bound to a reactive model on input events.
Controlled form that mounts after a skeleton and re-renders four times a second for a "last synced" clock, writing the model back into each input on every render.
Angular-style reactive form bootstrapped into app-root after half a second: formcontrolname attributes, ng-* state classes, labels inside mat-style wrappers.
NAS admin desktop: an "Account" step with an arrow button, then a password step greeting the user by name with a "Stay signed in" tick.
Home automation hub: the authorize page puts its log-in form two open shadow roots deep, with a "keep me logged in" tick and the client name in text.
Hypervisor web UI: a widget-toolkit login window over a dimmed console, generated ids, and read-only combo boxes for realm and language.
Media server sign-in: first a grid of user avatars and a "Manual Login" button, then a username and password form revealed in place.
Metrics dashboard log-in rendered by a client bundle after a short delay: "Email or username" and "Password" with test ids, an OAuth button and a forgot link.
Container manager log-in in an older two-way-binding framework: ng-model attributes, icon-prefixed inputs with placeholders only, and an OAuth link.
Self-hosted git forge: "Username or Email Address" sign-in under a navbar with a repository search box, plus a hidden OpenID tab.
Router admin "Authorization Required" page: a table form whose username box comes pre-filled with "root", and a password box.
Password-protected wiki "Log In" page: labels wrapping their inputs, one-letter field names, and a quick-search box in the page header.
Self-hosted notes app with a single password box and no username at all, as personal knowledge bases often have.
IP camera embedded web server opened as a bare IP and port: uppercase old HTML, a font-tag table, short field names and a client-side hash on submit.
Basic-auth style prompt drawn as a page: a centred sheet saying the server at an IP and port wants a username and password, with Cancel and Sign in.
Network ad-blocker admin: a password-only log-in box, a remember-for-a-week tick, a domain lookup box in the header and a collapsed "Forgot password?" note.
Uptime monitor single-page app: the log-in card mounts after a delay with framework floating labels (input before label) and a remember-me switch.
Torrent client web UI on a bare IP and port: no form element, two inputs in a div and an input-button with a click handler.
Build server log-in with servlet-container field names (j_username, j_password), a keep-me-signed-in tick and a simple centred panel.
First-run setup of a container manager: create the initial administrator, username pre-filled with "admin", password and confirm, and a statistics tick.
French insurer customer area: "Identifiant" and "Mot de passe", no autocomplete hints, "Se souvenir de moi" tick.
Spanish marketplace: "Correo electrónico" and "Contraseña" with "Iniciar sesión", a product search box in the header.
German utility customer portal: "Benutzername" and "Kennwort", "Angemeldet bleiben", labels in a definition-list layout.
Japanese online bookshop: "メールアドレス" and "パスワード", "ログイン状態を保持する", and a keyword search in the header.
Brazilian Portuguese store: "CPF ou e-mail" as the identifier, "Senha", "Entrar" and "Esqueci minha senha".
Recipe site registration: email, password and confirm password with a terms tick; a newsletter box sits in the footer.
Community sign-up with a public username, a separate email and a single new password with a live rules checklist and show toggle.
German bike shop registration: Vorname, Nachname, E-Mail-Adresse, Passwort and "Passwort wiederholen", without autocomplete hints.
Craft marketplace sign-up with one password, a display:none bot trap, an optional referral code box and a "how did you hear" select.
Travel site "Join" button opens a slide-in panel asking for full name, email and a password with a strength bar.
Accounting app settings page: a profile section with pre-filled display name and email, then a security section with current, new and confirm password.
Reset page reached from an email link: new and confirm password only, with the account name in a hidden username input for password managers.
French grocery delivery account: "Mot de passe actuel", "Nouveau mot de passe", "Confirmer le nouveau mot de passe", no autocomplete hints.
Corporate "Your password has expired" page shown after log-in: the user name as plain text, then old password, new password and re-enter.
Cloud console two-factor page: one box with one-time-code autocomplete for an authenticator app, a trust-this-browser tick and a recovery-code link.
Game account verification with six one-character boxes, aria-labels per digit, auto-advance and paste spreading.
Spanish mobile carrier SMS check: "Código de verificación" box with a numeric keyboard and a resend countdown.
Document app new-device check: an alphanumeric "XXXX-XXXX" code emailed to the user, one text box with no autocomplete hint.
Ride-hailing phone check: four telephone-keyboard boxes for an SMS code, no labels beyond the heading.
Outdoor shop checkout: name on card, a number box that groups digits as you type, month and year selects, CVC, and a coupon box in the order summary.
Hosted payment fields: the name box is on the shop page, while number, expiry and CVC each sit in their own iframe from another origin and talk to the page by postMessage.
Charity donation page: amount buttons and an "other amount" number box, then card number, a combined MM/YY expiry with a slash mask, CVV and name on card.
Bakery delivery address without autocomplete hints: full name, two address lines, suburb, state select, postcode, country select, phone, and a delivery-notes box.
Software billing profile with autocomplete hints: first and last name, company, address, city, ZIP, country select and phone, plus a VAT number box.
Help-centre search results: the big search box holds the query "reset password", with a sort select beside it.
Newsletter landing page: first name and email with a Subscribe button, nothing else.
Blog post comment form: name, email "(will not be published)", website and the comment itself.
Bot check before a download: a box drawn on a canvas shows a code, and one text box asks you to type the characters from the box.
Password strength demo on a security blog: one password box with a live meter and crack-time estimate, used only to test a made-up password.
Small-business contact form: name, email, phone, a subject select and a message.
Shopping cart: quantity number boxes for two items and a promo code box with an Apply button.
Gift card balance check: a card number box and a PIN box filled from an on-screen keypad (the PIN box is read-only and masked).
Wi-Fi QR code generator: network name, network password (masked), security select; makes a code for guests to scan.
Product page delivery estimator: quantity box, a postcode box and a country select to work out shipping cost.
Support chat widget opened in the corner: optional name and email for a transcript, and a message box.
Domain name availability checker: a name box and a top-level-domain select with a Search button.
Age gate in front of a winery site: day, month and year selects for the date of birth and a country select.
Developer settings page that has just created an access token: a read-only box shows the new token, next to boxes for another token's name and expiry.
Create-a-poll form in a team app: question, three answer options and a closing date.
Order tracking page for guests: order number and the email used at checkout, no account involved.
